# AKARRA

> AKARRA is an India-based handcrafted home decor brand based in Jaipur, Rajasthan.

## Brand
- Brand name: AKARRA
- Website: https://akarra.online/
- Business focus: handcrafted character objects, incense holders, home accents and gifting.
